Section.Label: sec:IteratingOverOrdersOfSimpleGroups
Section.Heading: Iterating over the orders of simple groups

ManSection.Returns: an iterator which iterates over the orders of non-abelian finite simple groups, in ascending order, starting at order start if specified, up to order finish if specified.

Section.Label: sec:OrdersOfSimpleGroups
Section.Heading: Helper functions for computing orders of simple groups

ManSection.Returns: the order of the simple group from the series indicated by the name of the respective function, specified by the parameters passed as arguments.
